annotations.title: Look up one Story by id

description: What can be known about one story id, usually from a story_reply or story_mention item in list_inbox: its caption, posted time and permalink while it is live, or that it has expired. `state` is live, readable, not_a_story, expired, not_found or unknown. Meta serves a Story for 24 hours and answers an expired one with the same error as a wrong id, so pass repliedAt (the item’s `at`) and the url so an expiry can be stated and a match found. unknown means a read failed, not that the Story is gone. Read-only, 0 credits.

account.description: one Instagram account: an @handle or id

brand.description: WHICH PROFILE the post lives in — id or exact name from list_brands (a shared workspace: its profile id). Needed when it was published in a profile this connection is not pinned to; applies to THIS CALL ONLY. A name that matches no profile, or two, is REFUSED and nothing is done.

repliedAt.description: when the reply arrived, the item’s `at`; a reply older than 24 hours means the Story has expired

storyId.description: the story id from the inbox item, or a media id

url.description: the story url from the same inbox item

name: get_meta_story
title: Look up one Story by id
